text:
maya_sales: Hey team — RetailCorp wants an air-gapped on-prem POC. Main asks: USB delivery, strict no-call-home, HSM-anchored offline activation (FIPS 140-2), and an update cadence they call \"monthly preferred, emergency hotfixes as needed\". Need a short preflight checklist + rough pricing by EOD.

lucas_se: TL;DR we can do USB + offline activation. Question: do they require us to perform final signing inside their HSM or will they re-sign after we deliver? That affects ops/legal.

maya_sales: They said: \"prefer Redwood-signed artifact for verification plus an activation token we import into our HSM\". They explicitly asked no telemetry and monthly attestations.

tara_ops: Operational points:
- We can produce a zero-telemetry bundle using `--no-telemetry`. That triggers extra QA (3-5 business days) and manual verification steps on our side.
- USB packaging will be a signed ZIP with `manifest.json`, `sbom.json`, `signature.sig`, and `verify_bundle.sh`.
- For >3 updates we recommend setting up a local repo mirror; USB is reasonable for <3 monthly patches.

seth_eng: Delta vs full image: delta minibundles supported for runtime & app layers. Constraints:
- If model quantization/profile changes or KV cache layout changes -> delta incompatible -> full image required.
- Deltas require strict version pinning and explicit `delta_from` in manifest.
- We detect incompatibility at build time and will flag in release notes.

ana_sec: (typo) ana_sec: Security notes:
- We do NOT retain customer private keys. Recommended flow: Redwood produces a signed artifact (our signature), customer verifies and re-signs with their HSM during import.
- We can produce a signed attestation PDF per release containing build hash, SBOM digest, and CI build metadata for auditors.
- If customer insists we use their HSM for final signing, legal must sign an addendum; also expect on-prem ops presence and audited access.

lucas_se: Example manifest we'll include in each bundle for them to inspect:
```
{
  "bundle_version": "2024-11-07",
  "delta_from": "2024-10-07",
  "signed_by": "redwood-rel-2024-11",
  "hsm_anchor": "sha256:<customer-pem-fingerprint>",
  "sbom": "sbom-2024-11.json",
  "notes": "delta-only if model profile unchanged"
}
```

tara_ops: Verify helper (`verify_bundle.sh`) will run SHA256 checks, validate `signature.sig` against `redwood-verify.pub`, and exit non-zero on mismatch. We'll include instructions to import our public key into their verification tools.

maya_sales: Pricing sketch? They asked for POC + 3 months of deltas.

lucas_se: Rough numbers (ballpark): one-time packaging & USB prep = $16k, SBOM + attestation pack = $3k, monthly signed-delta retainer = $3k/month, emergency full-image hotfix support = $5k/event. If we must integrate with customer HSM for final signing, add a one-time integration/legal ops fee (~$12k) and longer lead time.

ana_sec: Also call out legal caveat: joint signing or Redwood access to customer HSM materially changes liability. Mark as "legal review required" in the SOW.

seth_eng: Timeline estimate (no quant churn):
- Onboarding + HSM fingerprint collection: 2 business days
- Packaging pipeline + `--no-telemetry` build config: 4 business days
- Build + SBOM + internal test: 7 business days
- USB burn + verification scripts + docs: 3 business days
Total ~3-4 weeks. If quant work or HSM integration required, add 2-3 weeks.

pkg-bot: job `usb-bundle-pkg` queued for `poc/RetailCorp` (job id rb-173210). ETA: 2024-11-15T09:45Z.

lucas_se: Draft preflight checklist to send to customer (copyable):
- Provide HSM public cert fingerprint (PEM) and vendor/model + FIPS level.
- Confirm `--no-telemetry` requirement (explicit opt-out).
- Delivery method: courier USB (chain-of-custody) or internal repo mirror. If USB, provide ship-to contact and custody policy.
- Allowed maintenance windows and acceptable monthly cadence.
- Acceptance tests: signature verification, cold-start model load, p99 latency under target load, functional smoke tests.
- Retention/rollback plan: customer to keep previous full-image snapshot; deltas are not guaranteed reversible across quant changes.
- Provide preferred emergency contact for hotfix windows.

maya_sales: Perfect. I'll send checklist + pricing sketch to RetailCorp and request HSM fingerprint + courier details. Will note legal review if they ask for HSM-internal signing. Thanks all :thumbsup:

seth_eng: I'll add a short caveat in the SOW about quantized-model-triggered full-image replacements so expectations are clear.

ana_sec: I'll start drafting the security questionnaire answers and the attestation template.

maya_sales: Aim to reply by EOD. If customer pushes for final signing inside their HSM, I'll loop legal and schedule a short call.
